about_the_game:
《After the Long Night》: A Thrilling Apocalyptic Adventure

In the post - apocalyptic wasteland, do you long for a challenging and exciting adventure? "After the Long Night", an apocalyptic construction + RTS game, will lead you into a town full of zombies and crises, starting a heart - pounding survival journey.

Everything's a Resource, Build Freely

In the world of "After the Long Night", the entire city is your resource treasure trove. There may be precious tools hidden in houses, metal parts can be dismantled from old vehicles, and even roadside signs can be put to good use. Bring the scavenged resources back to the town and freely plan and build your base. There are no fixed patterns here, only your unlimited creativity.

Unique Combat Units, Battle Zombies in Style

Combat is a major highlight of "After the Long Night". The game features unique combat units. Drive vehicles like tanks and charge through the zombie hordes. Listen to the roar of the engine and the growls of the zombies. This unique combat experience will definitely make your adrenaline soar.

Traditional Construction Mechanics, Create Your Dream Sanctuary

Want to experience the traditional fun of apocalyptic construction? No problem! In "After the Long Night", you can command workers to pick up axes to cut down trees and open up land for farming. Gather resources and gradually build strong defensive works to create a cozy shelter.

Massive On - screen Action, Face the Terrifying Zombie Swarms

The most thrilling part is the zombie swarm battles with thousands of units on the screen. When the dense zombies surge like a tide, you need to rationally allocate resources and command combat units. Rely on your strategy and courage to hold the last line of defense. Every successful defense against the zombie swarm brings an unparalleled sense of accomplishment.

In "After the Long Night", every choice matters for survival, and every construction is filled with hope. Come and start this apocalyptic adventure, and write your own survival legend!

  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 960
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Long Dark Night is a sandbox survival game set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies. Players build bases, gather resources, craft weapons, and face constant threats from both zombies. The game features free construction and strategic defense, where only the strongest will survive.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Indonesian, Turkish, Japanese, Polish, Thai, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America, Vietnamese, Korean
